decision_conditions: Condition : 1 - With appropriate safeguarding conditions the signs would not be harmful to the appearance of the street scene and highway safety in compliance with policies ENV-B.1.1 (All New Development), ENV-B.1.4 (Advertisements), S.4.2 (Shop Front Design), and S.4.3 (Advertisements) of the adopted Hounslow Unitary Development Plan.

Condition : 2 - The proposed development shall be carried out in all respects in accordance with the proposals contained in the application and the plans submitted therewith and approved by the Local Planning Authority, or as shall have been otherwise agreed in writing by the Local Planning Authority before the building is used.

(Reason.  To ensure the development is carried out in accordance with the planning permission)

Condition : 3 - All advertisements displays, and any site used for the display of advertisements shall be maintained in a clean and tidy condition to the reasonable satisfaction of the Local Planning Authority.

(reason.  To accord with the Town and Country Planning (Control of Advertisement) Regulations 1992)

Condition : 4 - Any structure or hoarding erected or used principally for the purpose of displaying advertisements shall be maintained in a safe condition.

(reason.  To accord with the Town and Country Planning (Control of Advertisement) Regulations 1992)

Condition : 5 - Where any advertisement is required under these regulations to be removed, the removal shall be carried out to the reasonable satisfaction of the Local Planning Authority.

(reason.  To accord with the Town and Country Planning (Control of Advertisement) Regulations 1992)

Condition : 6 - No advertisement is to be displayed without the permission of the owner of the site or any other person with an interest in the site entitled to grant planning permission.

(Reason.  To accord with the Town and Country Planning (Control of Advertisement) Regulations 1992)

Condition : 7 - No advertisment shall be sited or displayed so as to obscure, or hinder, the ready interpretation of any road sign, railway sign or aid to navigation by water or air so as to otherwise render hazardous the use of any highway, railway, waterway ( including any coastal waters) or aerodrome (civil or military).

(reason.  To accord with the Town and Country Planning (Control of Advertisement) Regulations 1992)
description: Installation of 1 x fascia sign and 1 x projecting sign both internally illuminated.
